name: Chris Lowry
education: Bachelor's degree in chemistry, University of Wyoming; grew up attending public schools in Sweetwater County (2024 WyoFile questionnaire)
background: In his 2024 WyoFile questionnaire, Chris Lowry wrote that he lived in Laramie, had lived there 27 years and in Wyoming almost 47 years, was born in Cottage Grove, Oregon, and would be 50 on Nov. 5, 2024. He wrote that he grew up in Sweetwater County and attended public schools there before moving to Laramie, and that as a single father he earned a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the University of Wyoming. He described himself as a chemist, sportsman, and outdoorsman, and said he had lived in House District 46 for four years at the time of the questionnaire.
